newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 626,200 MT were 6 percent above the previous week, but 8 percent below the 4-week average. The primary purchasers were Japan (141,800 MT), Taiwan (111,600 MT), South Korea (108,000 MT), Egypt (53,500 MT), and Mexico (52,200 MT).
Sales increases of 474,900 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were mainly for unknown destinations (386,300 MT) and Japan (80,300 MT).

Exports of 704,400 MT were 9 percent above the week earlier and 6 percent above the 4-week average. The principal recipients were Japan (362,400 MT), Mexico (65,500 MT), Portugal (63,200 MT), Egypt (53,500 MT), and Taiwan (48,100 MT).
